title: Exact Bellman distance-to-go and STOP calibration in a sound native TypedLoop Horn policy

ownership.AF16_scientific_result: local primary FAIL; seeds 17/29 immediate STOP on deep provable goals
ownership.scope: Own subtree and workflow only; AF-01 through AF-16 source, registrations and scientific results remain unchanged

question: Does Bellman action-distance and state-reachability supervision improve compact Horn proof-search policy on new rule-composition graphs beyond explicit STOP calibration and an extra-compute imitation control?

data.train_states: AF16 shortest-proof states plus deterministic first/second legal-rule detour states, all train-only
data.disjointness: Hash all public physical graph/fact inputs; verify no heldout matches AF16 train, dev or prior evaluated AF16 cases
data.leakage_guard: No exact proof costs, reachability labels, Bellman teacher values, future proof actions or model targets enter the neural inputs; host provides only current proved bits and legal-action mask
data.test_access: Frozen checkpoints exported before any heldout score is inspected or used for updates

host_semantics.soundness: Host alone fires one eligible rule with all premises proved and fresh head, or executes STOP; neural scores cannot directly add atoms
host_semantics.budget: Exact independent minimum number of rule fires plus one for a provable goal; unprovable goals permit two actions
host_semantics.oracle: Training exact DP d(S); independent verifier reads physical graph and computes fresh BFS for goal reachability, distance, every accepted inference and sampled rule cost
host_semantics.Bellman: For provable unsolved S: d(S)=1+min_a d(S_a); Q(S,a)=1+d(S_a); unprovable successor costs capped to 10
host_semantics.STOP: Cost 10 when a goal remains reachable and not yet proved, cost 0 at an already proved or unreachable state; this is a training target and not a host reachability mask
host_semantics.cost_to_logit: For every actual host-legal action, supervised target logit=(10-capped_cost)/3, with unreachable or early STOP cost 10 and proved/unreachable STOP cost 0
host_semantics.formal: Pure Lean 4 Bellman ranking-gap theorem and exact successor-cost statements; neural learned policies are evaluated independently

model.cell: Verbatim AF15 source-hash-pinned TypedLoop width16, two calls per decision
model.policy: AF15 action/logit heads with two additional linear state distance and reachability heads; STOP logit subtracts 0.75 times learned reachability logit in every arm
model.inference: All arms choose argmax raw logits after the identical host legal-action mask; host does not use its oracle to suppress STOP

training.sampling: 16 original AF15 train states and 16 AF16 new-composition train states, matching every arm for first 240 draws; deterministic detour-state augmentation
training.initialization_seed_formula: 81700+seed; all arms use identical initial state dict
training.sampler_seed_formula: 817017+seed; all arms use identical prefix minibatches
training.optimizer: AdamW lr .002, weight decay .01, gradient clip 1.0
training.loss_imitation: negative log probability of exact shortest-goal legal action set
training.loss_stop: imitation plus .65 STOP-vs-best-legal BCE with .25 weighted reachability head BCE; STOP labels from exact source shortest proof
training.loss_bellman: stop loss plus .55*(Huber(raw legal logits, (10-capped_action_cost)/3) +.5*Huber(predicted state distance, clipped d(S)/3))
training.comparison_fairness: All arms have same architecture and action selection, same initial weights, original training data and sampler; imitation/stop/bellman each use 240 native forward schedules, extra imitation has 360 updates (50% more). STOP/Bellman losses add backward arithmetic and are not exact FLOP matched
training.checkpoint_selection: Always fixed final optimizer step; never select by heldout; retain complete failed/ineligible seeds and negative results
training.runtime: Local Python 3.13 Torch 2.10 CPU two threads; registered hosted Python 3.12 Torch 2.5.1 CPU and Lean 4.19.0 are separately validated if CI runners are available

evaluation.eligibility: STOP and Bellman arms individually require train provable-goal success >=.75 and dev >=.65 before heldout comparison
evaluation.primary: Every eligible seed must show Bellman minus stop-calibration success >=.05 and Bellman minus 360-update extra imitation success >=.02 on both depth4/5, absolute Bellman >=.75, and Bellman no more than .03 below fixed rule order, <=.05 early STOP on reachable goals and zero host false accepted proofs
evaluation.aggregate_rule: Any eligible failure gives FAIL, all 4 eligible passes gives PASS, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; preserve all scores
record: early STOP rate on provable goals
evaluation.scientific_scope: Finite structured Horn DAGs and these proof budgets only; no independent Lean theorem proving claim
